# scripts/Cinema/CineOperator.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Cinema/CineOperator.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Moves a Camera3D from framing dictionaries using damped translation/aim, eased lens/focus, sway, and impact shake.
Uses real time so cinematography continues during slow motion. Observe and drama select speed/turn limits.
An actor-only eye light belongs to fx_light and is excluded from gameplay light arithmetic.
attach() saves lens/attributes; stand_down() restores them. CineScreen handles captured-frame transitions.

Base: `Node`. Registered class: `none`.

### show

```gdscript
func show(framing: Dictionary, how: StringName) -> void
```

[Source:192](../../../../../scripts/Cinema/CineOperator.gd#L192)

A new shot, `how`: "cut" (there at once), "glide" (moved there; a cut if
a wall is in the way), "path" (along framing.path, at the mode's speed),
"wipe" (the last frame wiped away over the new shot, cut to), "dissolve"
(the last frame fading out over it) or "fade" (down to black, cut to
there, and up). Headless, the last three are plain cuts.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `framing` | `Dictionary` | required |
| `how` | `StringName` | required |

Return type: `void`.
